questionText: What are HTTP status code ranges and what does each range mean?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can read an HTTP status from its broad class to its exact meaning and avoid replacing protocol status with a JSON flag.
inScope: The meaning of the five status classes
How an unknown code is handled by class
Why the exact code, headers, and body still matter
outOfScope: A complete catalog of registered status codes
prerequisites: Basic HTTP request and response structure

claims.statement: Valid HTTP response status codes are three-digit integers from 100 through 599, and their first digit defines the 1xx through 5xx response class.
A client that does not recognize an extension status code still understands its class and treats the unrecognized code as equivalent to the x00 code of that class.
One request can receive zero or more informational 1xx responses followed by one final response from another status class.
A 304 Not Modified response is a 3xx response used after a conditional GET or HEAD so the client can reuse a stored response without receiving new representation content.
Response content can explain an occurrence, but the response status code remains the protocol result and cannot be replaced by an application-level success or error flag.
A server-error class alone does not make a retry safe; retry behavior also depends on method semantics and the application's duplicate-prevention contract.

validation.command: Parse the status line, Content-Type header, and JSON response body shown in the lesson
validation.expected: A valid 404 response whose JSON body adds an application code and safe message

visuals.title: Five status classes with representative codes and client actions

notes: The teaching table samples codes; it is not presented as a complete IANA status-code registry.
The retry warning is deliberately tied to method and API semantics rather than a simple 5xx rule.

review.notes: Status-class, unknown-code, 304, and retry claims were checked against RFC 9110 and RFC 9111; the HTTP example parsed and the comparison table matches those claims.
